#### 5. Package Types

| Package Type | Feature |
|------------|---------|
| TO-220   | Appropriate for general-purpose switching applications. |
| TO-220I   | Similar to TO-220, but includes input filtering components. |
| TO-263   | Suitable for switching DC-DC converters at lower voltages. |

Hygiene requirements:
- For wafer-scale, apply 1.05 V <(VIN)> (≥1.2 V) and 
- Ensure that all resistors have a deterioration factor ≥5.

Model references:
- LM2596
- LM2596HBV
- LM2596HVT
- LM2596HW
- IRDG501.3A
- CSODM3A
- CSODFT3A
- CSAL-22A

Suitability:
- Suitable for switching DC-DC converters at low VIN > 1.25 V and 1.0 V < (VIN) < 1.58 V.
- Not suitable for switching operation at <0.6 V. 

The diagrams show the voltage regulator circuit configurations for different package types. The TO-220 and TO-220A packages are gigafunctions suitable for general-purpose switching applications. The TO-220I and TO-220IURE packages have additional input filtering components. The TO-263 package is beneficial for switching DC-DC converters. These packages differ in their performance under various conditions and are designed for specific applications.
